v1.description: Someone asks for a day off; their approver accepts or refuses it. The whole process, so that every piece of the engine has something real to run as it is built.
v1.bpmnXml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:bpmndi="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/DI"
                  xmlns:dc="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DC"
                  xmlns:di="http://www.omg.org/spec/DD/20100524/DI"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="timeOffRequestDefinitions"
                  targetNamespace="https://iap.uhndata.io/demos/timeOffRequest">
  <bpmn:process id="timeOffRequest" name="Time off request" isExecutable="true">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="requestSubmitted" name="Request submitted">
      <bpmn:outgoing>toApproval</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="toApproval" sourceRef="requestSubmitted" targetRef="approveRequest" />
    <bpmn:userTask id="approveRequest" name="Approve the request">
      <bpmn:incoming>toApproval</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>toDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="toDecision" sourceRef="approveRequest" targetRef="decision" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="decision" name="Approved?" default="toRejected">
      <bpmn:incoming>toDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>toApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>toRejected</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="toApproved" sourceRef="decision" targetRef="requestApproved">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">outcome == 'approved'</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="toRejected" sourceRef="decision" targetRef="requestRejected" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="requestApproved" name="Time off approved">
      <bpmn:incoming>toApproved</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="requestRejected" name="Time off refused">
      <bpmn:incoming>toRejected</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
  </bpmn:process>
  <bpmndi:BPMNDiagram id="timeOffRequestDiagram">
    <bpmndi:BPMNPlane id="timeOffRequestPlane" bpmnElement="timeOffRequest">
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="requestSubmittedShape" bpmnElement="requestSubmitted">
        <dc:Bounds x="160" y="180" width="36" height="36" />
        <bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
          <dc:Bounds x="139" y="223" width="79" height="14" />
        </bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="approveRequestShape" bpmnElement="approveRequest">
        <dc:Bounds x="250" y="158" width="100" height="80" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="decisionShape" bpmnElement="decision" isMarkerVisible="true">
        <dc:Bounds x="405" y="173" width="50" height="50" />
        <bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
          <dc:Bounds x="404" y="143" width="53" height="14" />
        </bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="requestApprovedShape" bpmnElement="requestApproved">
        <dc:Bounds x="522" y="100" width="36" height="36" />
        <bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
          <dc:Bounds x="500" y="143" width="81" height="14" />
        </bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNShape id="requestRejectedShape" bpmnElement="requestRejected">
        <dc:Bounds x="522" y="260" width="36" height="36" />
        <bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
          <dc:Bounds x="502" y="303" width="77" height="14" />
        </bpmndi:BPMNLabel>
      </bpmndi:BPMNShape>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="toApprovalEdge" bpmnElement="toApproval">
        <di:waypoint x="196" y="198" />
        <di:waypoint x="250" y="198" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="toDecisionEdge" bpmnElement="toDecision">
        <di:waypoint x="350" y="198" />
        <di:waypoint x="405" y="198" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="toApprovedEdge" bpmnElement="toApproved">
        <di:waypoint x="430" y="173" />
        <di:waypoint x="430" y="118" />
        <di:waypoint x="522" y="118" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
      <bpmndi:BPMNEdge id="toRejectedEdge" bpmnElement="toRejected">
        <di:waypoint x="430" y="223" />
        <di:waypoint x="430" y="278" />
        <di:waypoint x="522" y="278" />
      </bpmndi:BPMNEdge>
    </bpmndi:BPMNPlane>
  </bpmndi:BPMNDiagram>
</bpmn:definitions>
